x: Henry Martin produced a promising early season effort in the quarter when running a close second to Woodland of Hercules(52.0) and, although only placed fifth, it was good to see Jim Heathfield running quarters once more after his third retirement from the event!

In the final Clive was drawn on the outside lane, while the holder, Woodland of Hercules, was blessed with the inside. However, Woodland had to put up a Best Championship Performance of 48·4 in beating Clive's 49·4.
At the halfway mark he had all but caught Woodland (Hercules) who was in the lane outside him and his time of 52.2 promises good things to come in better conditions.
